name: Strawberry Tarte
source:
Modern time. There exists a magic group established during Heian period with the role to reconcile governmental institutions. Main character is its executive and special exterminationist with the  mission is to defeat the sorcerer and his tentacle monsters.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在现代。有一个成立于平安时代的魔法组织，职责是协调政府机构之间的关系。主人公是组织的干部，也是一名特殊讨伐者，肩负着消灭某位术士及其触手魔物的使命。

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
